mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over the previous three months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5% for two consecutive months indicates a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing corporate profit margins and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A sequential decline in both real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and new home sales (HOUST) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening consumer and housing demand, which reduces corporate revenue and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals an expansion in economic output and capacity utilization, which supports higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the unemployment rate and payroll employment (PAYEMS) month-over-month, where unemployment rises while payroll employment increases, signals a shift in labor composition toward lower-wage or part-time work, reducing average labor productivity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases AND PAYEMS increases in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate held constant at or below 1% for six consecutive months in a low-inflation environment signals accommodative monetary policy, which supports risk asset valuations and results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS <= 1.0% for 6 consecutive months AND CPIAUCSL annualized < 2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous two-month decline in both industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based contraction in supply-side activity, which reduces corporate earnings and increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.
